title: Sequential X-rays to predict COVID-19 deterioration
summary: Models trained in part on 26,838 X-rays from 4,914 patients predict deterioration up to 96 hours ahead, outperforming specialists in some retrospective comparisons. This research is for hospital resource planning, not a clinical product or evidence of better patient outcomes.

evidence.tested: Models trained on chest X-rays are compared with specialists in some retrospective comparisons for predicting deterioration.
evidence.unknown: Not reported in the arXiv abstract read; the research is for resource planning, not a clinical product.
evidence.ai_role: Self-supervised learning (MoCo) predicted COVID-19 deterioration from sequential chest X-rays.
